models.$description: Map of model_id → model-specific settings. Unknown models fall back to 'defaults'.
models.input: Modalities the model can receive. Valid: 'text', 'image'. Controls which media types extendedRead returns. Video is read as image frames, so 'image' is required for video too. If 'image' is absent, image/video files return a note instead of media.

maxBytes.$description: Per-modality size caps (bytes). Larger files return a note.
maxBytes.image: Default: 10485760 (10 MB). Video bypasses the cap (frame count scales with duration); audio is probe-only (info=true).

defaults.$description: Fallback for models not listed in 'models'.
defaults.ffmpegTimeoutMs: ffmpeg timeout (ms) for conversion, cropping, gating, and frame extraction. Default: 30000.

imageGate.$description: The ffmpeg image gate every emitted raster passes through.
imageGate.maxDim: Max width or height after gating (px). Over-limit images are downscaled. Default: 2000.
imageGate.maxBytes: Base64 budget (bytes) for the serialized image; the quality ladder steps down to fit. Default: 4718592 (4.5 MB).
imageGate.jpegQuality: Starting JPEG quality (1-100) for derived rasters; the ladder steps down by 5 to 65. Default: 80.

pdf.maxPagesPerCall: Max pages per tool call. Default: 10.
